author: LGR
description:
Diving into the Deja View Camwear 100 from late 2003! Camera glasses aren't all that odd anymore but the way these work fits the bill. A little video camera that connects to a Walkman-like device and only records *after* you see something happen. The goal is to be a head mounted TiVo for instant replays of reality! Or maybe it was about capturing bagel stealing squirrel thieves...
